title: BESTÅ TV storage combination
description: BESTÅ TV storage combination, black-brown/Lappviken/Stubbarp black-brown, 941/2x161/2x901/2" It’s easy to keep the cords from your TV and other devices out of sight but close at hand, as there are several cord outlets at the back of the TV bench.
features: We recommend a TV bench to be a bit wider than the TV placed on it. This TV bench suits a TV up to 99 inches. You can choose a larger TV if it’s not heavier than the specified max load for the bench’s top.
If you choose the soft closing function for your BESTÅ, we recommend complementing the fronts with knobs/handles to make the drawers/cabinets more convenient to open.
The top panel of the TV bench is intended for a TV with a maximum weight of 35 lbs.
Knobs and handles are sold separately.
The max load for a wall-hung frame depends on the wall material.
Different wall materials require different types of fasteners. Use fasteners suitable for the walls in your home.
